caption: The drawing features a single green glass bottle centered against a pale, light-colored background. The bottle is cylindrical with a rounded shoulder and a short neck topped by a rounded lip. The surface of the bottle has embossed text that reads “WILLINGTON GLASS Co WEST WILLINGTON CONN.” The green coloration of the glass is deep and somewhat translucent, with some areas appearing lighter due to highlights and light reflection. The overall composition is minimal, with the bottle occupying the majority of the visual space and no other objects or background elements present. The drawing is rendered with careful shading to give the bottle a three-dimensional appearance, and the artist's signature, “MAUD M HOLME,” is visible in small letters in the lower left corner.
title: Liberty Glass Bottle
